description: Land Title Settlement Department - Akaragama, Divulapitiya D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510096
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a formal declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Nos. 270, 272, and 273) in Akaragama village, including detailed ownership particulars, property extents, encumbrances, and legal descriptions. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it concerns land registration, property ownership, and title settlement matters.
